benefit_summary: 1Password publishes no startup-specific credits or discount program. Its business pricing FAQ enumerates the discount categories it does offer, and startups are not among them.
Airtable runs an application-gated startup program, but publishes no benefit amount, duration, eligibility criteria or terms on any reachable page — the application form body is JS-rendered.

Australia/New Zealand program tiered by funding stage. Pre-seed gets the Explore tier free for 3 months; Seed gets the Grow tier free for 3 months plus AUD$100,000 of fee-free payment collection and AUD$100,000 of fee-free FX; Series A+ is sales-handled.
Up to $120,000 in Akamai Cloud credits in year one of a three-year program, with discounts rather than credits in years two and three.
$10,000 in Algolia credit usable within the first 12 months after approval, for new or free-tier accounts only; unused credit lapses and accounts move to pay-as-you-go once the credit is spent.
Up to $120k in Alibaba Cloud credits plus up to 2B free Model Studio tokens, POC coupons, 1:1 office hours with AI experts and 12 months of Alibaba Cloud Academy access.
Year one is the full Growth plan at 100% off, stated as a $60,000 value, with up to 100M events per month (~200k MTU) and unlimited teammates. Year two is 40% off the annual Plus plan.
Application-based program offering Claude API credits plus upgraded API rate limits. No credit figure is published. Credits are usable only on the first-party Claude API via Claude Console.
50% off Apollo's Basic or Professional plan for 12 months, up to 5 seats, plus full B2B database access and 1:1 support.
A partner-issued discount code applied to a Starter or Advanced annual plan for the first 12 months of the subscription. No discount percentage or amount is published.
Twelve months of recurring monthly credits toward AssemblyAI speech APIs for early-stage teams building voice or audio products, with discounted pricing continuing afterwards.
Premium editions of Atlassian Cloud products at $0 for 12 months for up to 50 users, with Jira Product Discovery limited to 10 creator seats and unlimited contributors.

80% off the annual Pro plan plus credits in year one and 30% off in year two, for workspaces of up to 10 seats, with dedicated onboarding and third-party perks (3 months of Linear, 6 months of Notion).

AWS promotional credits by tier: up to $200,000 for pre-Series B startups applying with an Activate Provider's Org ID (Activate Portfolio), up to $5,000 for self-funded founders, and an invite-only AI tier above that.
Tiered AWS credits: up to $5,000 USD for self-funded founders applying directly, and up to $200,000 USD for pre-Series B startups holding an Org ID from an Activate Provider.
Two separate credit pools: up to $25,000 for Dedicated Inference or Training and up to $2,500 for Model APIs, plus priority support and GTM consulting.
A partner program for accelerators and VCs that gives their portfolio companies unspecified discounts on Brevo, plus integrations and dedicated support. No discount percentage or amount is published.

Brex cardholders get a catalogue of third-party partner perks, headlined on the startups page as "Over $350K in discounts and credits on AI and SaaS". The figure is stated as a floor, not a cap, so no maximum is recorded. A named subset is the "Day Zero Stack".
A free Carta cap table platform tier for startups that have raised less than $1M and have 25 stakeholders or fewer.

Up to $20,000 in free compute credits and up to 24 months of use, plus free Starter Support (stated as valued at $249 per month) and guided onboarding. Credit amount and promotional period vary by startup stage and location.

Three-stage cloud credit program offering up to $1,000 (Launchpad), up to $10,000 (Propel) or up to $50,000 (Elevate) in Civo credits, with technical support and community access; the program runs 6-12 months depending on stage.
Two-week live and async GTM accelerator cohort for pre-seed to Series A venture-backed startups; participants earn Clay credits as they progress through the programme. No credit amount is published.
An unspecified discount on Clerk Pro features for approved early-stage startups, on top of the standard free allowance of 50,000 monthly retained users and 100 monthly retained organizations.
Clerky customers get access to a catalogue of third-party startup perks, surfaced in the Perks and Banking tabs of the team dashboard. Clerky publishes no discount on its own legal products.

$5,000 in ClickHouse Cloud credits valid for 12 months plus ClickHouse Basic Support, available only to startups affiliated with a selected accelerator, incubator or VC partner who supply a verification code.
$3,000 in ClickUp credit plus an upgraded Enterprise workspace and onboarding resources, for startups affiliated with an approved ClickUp funding partner.
A startup-friendly deal on Close distributed through accelerator, incubator and startup-community perks marketplaces. No discount percentage, credit amount or duration is published.

Enterprise-level Cloudflare credits in three tiers keyed to how much the startup has raised: $10k, $100k or $350k. Credits are valid for one year or until fully consumed. Tiers 1 and 2 require funding from an affiliated partner.
Six months of the Coda Team plan free, plus startup-specific templates; unlimited Coda AI is included only for startups that apply through a Coda partner.

Cohere publishes a Startup Program page and a separate application page, but no benefit, amount, discount percentage or eligibility rule could be read from either; the program's terms are unconfirmed.

A 30% discount code applied to an eligible subscription on the Essentials or Plus plan, reviewed manually by the Crisp team; stated to remain attached to the subscription rather than expiring after a trial period.
Up to 12 months of Customer.io at $0, including up to 30,000 customer profiles, on a Startup plan that carries all Essentials features.
Up to $200K in credits split across Databricks and Neon, plus technical guidance and go-to-market access. Credit duration is not published.
Up to $100k in credits covering up to a year of free Datadog Pro across the full platform, for Series A or earlier companies referred by an official Datadog partner.

No reachable DataStax startup program page exists. Every former startup-program URL either 404s or cross-domain redirects to IBM's DataStax product page, which contains no startup program, eligibility or credit offer.
A 'Startup pricing bundle' with two published components: free U.S. payroll for founders for life, and the first 5 seats free for life for venture-backed startups that have raised at least $500k.
Up to $100,000 in Deepgram API credits usable within 12 months; direct applicants start at a $1,000 tier with upgrades, and partner-referred applicants may receive a different offer.
12 months of DigitalOcean credits set per startup by the approving partner, plus 15 months of free Standard-tier support. Participants generally have a $10,000 monthly credit usage limit.
25% off a startup's first Drata contract, presented on a Drata-hosted landing page whose only call to action is a demo request; no eligibility criteria, duration or region terms are published.
Scale plan for 12 months with 33,000,000 characters, which the page describes as over 680 hours of Agents usage and more than $5,500+ in value. Converts to the Free plan at the end of the term.

Credits for eligible venture-backed startups, expiring one year after joining, usable for inference, image generation, speech-to-text, embeddings, fine-tuning and on-demand GPU deployments. No credit amount is published.

A catalogue of third-party partner perks (e.g. AWS, Deepgram, Snowflake, Deel, Zoho) that Firstbase states is worth over $350,000 in aggregate; each perk has its own separate terms and there is no single per-company credit.

$50,000 of free Fivetran usage on the Standard plan over 12 months, plus complimentary technical support, for Y Combinator companies with 50 or fewer employees that are not current or former Fivetran customers.
A full year of the Framer Pro plan at no cost, stated by Framer as a $360 saving, for pre-seed or seed startups backed by a Framer approved partner that have not used Framer before.
Partner-referred discount on the Pro plan of Freshworks products, at percentages set in each startup's Service Order Form, claimable within one year of signup; capped at 30 agents per product.
No Front startup program page currently exists: the former program URL now permanently redirects to Front's general pricing page, which contains no startup offer.

$10,000 in flexible GitHub credits applied to an Enterprise account for up to 12 months, usable across GitHub Enterprise, Copilot, Advanced Security, Actions and other metered offerings; only available through an affiliated partner.

Two-tier, two-year program for new customers: Seed stage gets a free Ultimate licence for year one and 50% off in year two; Series A/B gets 50% off in year one and 25% off in year two. All tiers capped at 20 seats.

Start tier: up to $2,000 USD in credits over a year for startups not yet backed by equity funding. Scale tier: year-one Google Cloud and Firebase usage covered with credits up to $100,000, plus 20% of year-two usage covered up to an additional $100,000.

$100,000 in credits usable on any Grafana Cloud service for 12 months or until the next funding round, plus Enterprise data source plugins and 24x7 support, followed by a guaranteed 20% list-price discount.
No Groq startup-credits program page is currently reachable; Groq's official billing FAQ documents only occasional promotional credits tied to hackathons and special events.
Six months free on the Help Scout Plus plan for new customers that are incorporated tech startups under two years old with under $1 million ARR.

Tiered discount on net-new Professional or Enterprise HubSpot products: 90% off year one for VC-funded or partner-affiliated startups, or 30% off year one via approved entrepreneurial organizations, tapering in later years.

Tiered discount on the Intercom helpdesk from $33/month: 93% off in year one, 50% off in year two and 25% off in year three, with 300 free Fin outcomes and 15 Fin qualifications per month in year one.
50% off purchases of up to 10 IDE subscriptions, 10 paid team or learning tool subscriptions and 10 JetBrains AI subscriptions, available over a five-year enrolment period.

program: Exclusive offer for NVIDIA Inception and Connect members
benefit_summary: $7,500 in Lambda cloud credits toward on-demand NVIDIA GPU instances on Lambda's Public Cloud, limited to members of the NVIDIA Inception or NVIDIA Connect programs, one grant per company.

Two tiers: Build gives discounted seat pricing to first-time customers with under $10M raised; Scale gives $10K in LangSmith credits valid for 1 year to Series A or earlier startups backed by a LangChain premier VC partner.

No LaunchDarkly startup credits or startup discount program page could be found on launchdarkly.com; the pricing page advertises only a free Developer plan and a 14-day trial, neither framed as a startup program.

Free access to Linear's Business plan for startups affiliated with an official Linear partner; valid only for non-paying Linear users with fewer than 50 employees, redeemed through a partner link or code.

Catalogue of 305 third-party partner offers (credits and discounts) available to Mercury account holders, grouped into six themed bundles. Listed examples include AWS "$5k credits", GitHub "$10,000 in GitHub credits", Notion "6 months free + unlimited AI".

Azure credits for early-stage B2B startups in two paths: a no-referral path starting at $1,000 for 90 days, and an investor-referral path that Microsoft's FAQ says most startups begin at $100,000, with the landing page advertising up to $150,000.
A one-time Miro account credit: $1,000 for startups connected to a Miro Startup Program partner, or $500 for individual startups applying directly. One credit per startup.
One year free on the Mixpanel Startup plan including the full product suite, with 1 billion events and 1 million Session Replays; Mixpanel states the package is worth $145,000.
Free GPU credits (quantity not published) plus engineering and GTM support, in two VC-funding-gated tiers. Credits are a one-time grant per tier and applicants must be new to Modal.
Atlas credits and Voyage AI tokens delivered as a promo code, in four stage-based tiers (Inspire, Grow, Innovate, Scale). No credit figure is published for any tier.
Compute credits and discounts for AI startups, available only through Nebius venture capital partner funds. No credit amount is published.

Two tiers of credits valid 12 months: up to $1,000 in Neon credits for self-funded startups with under $1M raised, and up to $200K in Neon and Databricks credits for VC-backed startups with at least $1M raised or recognized-accelerator participants.
Free access to the New Relic platform for five users with a monthly data-ingest allowance, plus assigned engineering support; no dollar value, ingest figure, or duration is published.

Free months of the Notion Business plan with Notion AI included: 6 months for startups affiliated with select Notion partners, 3 months for those with a business website and company domain email, or 1 month for under-10-employee companies or incomplete applications.

Free membership bundling free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners, preferred pricing on select NVIDIA hardware and software, free self-paced technical courses, and VC network exposure. No dollar amounts published.

A five-week cohort program (approx. fifteen participants) of workshops, office hours and mentoring at OpenAI's San Francisco HQ, with early access to OpenAI tools and unspecified credits. Applications closed 12 Jan 2026.
The page currently points startups to Oracle Cloud Free Tier and developer resources. No credit amount, discount percentage, eligibility criteria or application form is published on it.
Two levels of free OVHcloud credits: EUR 10,000 with 6 hours of engineer time at Start level, and up to EUR 100,000 with up to 20 hours of engineer time at Scale level, for a maximum of 12 months.
Flat $750 price for the first year covering federal and state corporate income tax filings, monthly accrual-basis bookkeeping, onboarding, and setup help for banking, corporate card and payroll.
Free access to Pinecone's Standard tier and Pro Support, plus unspecified usage credits and discounts, for companies with fewer than 100 employees at Series A or earlier.
50% off Plain's Horizon plan: a $6k flat fee covering 12 months and 10 seats, for VC-backed startups with up to $5m in funding that are not already Plain customers.
$50,000 in PostHog platform credits valid for 12 months, plus merch and separate partner discounts (Incident.io, Speakeasy, Chroma, Depot) the page values at $12,000.
Companies that join Pulley through one of its partners receive a first-year discount and concierge onboarding. No discount percentage, amount or partner list is published.

No Puzzle startup credits or discount program terms are published. The Y Combinator partner page now redirects to the Puzzle homepage; the live startup and pricing pages publish only a 14-day free trial and general plan promotions.
20% discount on Qdrant Cloud for the first year (12 months from acceptance), plus expert technical sessions and partner perks from Hugging Face, LlamaIndex and Airbyte.
$5,000 in Railway credits announced in an April 2024 changelog for startups with $2M-$25M raised, founded 2020 or later, and under $100 lifetime Railway spend.

Access to a partner rewards marketplace Ramp states is worth $350K+ in credits and discounts, redeemed from the Ramp product dashboard after opening an account. Ramp publishes no eligibility criteria on the page.
The English Redis for Startups page no longer resolves: it redirects to the Redis homepage, so no current program terms, amounts or eligibility rules can be confirmed.

Percentage discount on Remote's service fees for startups. The readable page states partner-referred startups get 20% off all hires in their first year, and that introducing a non-partner investor adds 5% up to a 20% ceiling.

Four tiers of Render credits valid one year: $500 Prototype (open to all qualified startups), $2,500–$5K Build, $10K–$25K Scale and $100K AI; the Build, Scale and AI tiers require applying through an enrolled accelerator or VC partner.
A 100% off coupon for one year on a monthly Team or Business plan, with a value up to $60k, followed by a 25% discount on the paid plan in the second year.

Rippling hosts a startup landing page and accelerator-specific offer pages, but every Rippling page returned 403 to automated retrieval, so no offer term, duration or eligibility rule could be confirmed.
Two tiers: Growth Tier adds $25,000 in bonus credits on a $50,000 upfront commitment under a 12-month agreement; Starter Tier grants $1,000 in credits with self-serve onboarding.

Free and discounted Salesforce products for venture-backed startups, covering Starter Suite, Pro Suite, Sales Cloud Enterprise Edition, Agentforce, Tableau and Slack, plus implementation support. No cost to join; no amounts published.
Three stage-based cloud credit tiers: up to EUR 1,000 over one year (Founders), EUR 9,000 over six months (Early Stage), and EUR 36,000 over twelve months (Growth Stage).

No startup credits are offered. Twilio, which owns Segment, states every customer gets a small account-opening credit and that no additional credits are offered to startups. The former Segment Startup Program pages now redirect to Twilio.
Up to $5,000 in Sentry credits expiring after 12 months, plus priority support, for companies founded in the last 2 years that have raised under $5M in venture capital and have never paid for Sentry.
Free Snowflake usage on an eligible startup's first contract; the vendor publishes no dollar figure, duration, or eligibility thresholds on the program page.

Snyk's startups page is product marketing with "Book a live demo" and "Start free" calls to action; it publishes no startup-specific credit, discount, term length, eligibility test or application process.

Paid Delaware incorporation service ($500 one-time, $100/year thereafter) that includes $2,500 in Stripe product credits for the first year after incorporation and access to over $50,000 in third-party partner discounts.

The dedicated Stytch Startup Program page no longer exists; its URLs now redirect to general pricing, which advertises an always-free tier of 10,000 monthly active users with no startup-specific terms.

Supabase hosts an application form titled "Supabase Startup Deal Application Form", but publishes no benefit amount, duration, or eligibility criteria for it on any Supabase-owned page that could be read.

$220,000 day-one investment ($200,000 uncapped MFN SAFE plus $20,000 convertible equity agreement for 5% common stock) alongside a 3-month mentorship-driven accelerator program; Asia-Pacific programs invest $120,000 total.
Tiered program giving up to $15K, $30K or $50K in free Together AI platform credits plus 3, 6 or 10 hours of forward-deployed engineering time, with the tier set by how much the company has raised.
75% off Typeform's Business plan for one year, available only on a yearly plan, for seed-stage startups that are not already Typeform customers.
A $1,000 discount for new customers via the Vanta for Startups program, accessed by requesting a demo. Not combinable with other offers.
Up to $30,000 in what Vercel calls a Flexible Commitment Amount, plus Enterprise-tier access and startup-focused support.
Up to $100K in cloud credits plus 35% long-term discounts, executive sponsorship, architecture reviews and priority support, for startups with recent Series A through E financing.
A discount of unpublished size on Weaviate Cloud, redeemed by creating a Weaviate Console account and submitting a form naming your company and the program or VC you are affiliated with.
Closed program. Startups accepted before 30 June 2026 received a promo code for 100% off the first year of a monthly Premium Site plan; no new applications are accepted.

WorkOS publishes no startup-specific credit, discount or application. The quantified benefit on its startups page is the standard free tier: User Management/AuthKit free for the first 1 million monthly active users.
A sign-in-gated catalogue of third-party vendor discounts available to YC companies and to attendees of YC events that included exclusive deals. Individual deal terms are not public.
Free Zendesk Professional Suite and Copilot for up to 50 agents; baseline term is 6 months, with 1- or 2-year terms only for startups affiliated with Zendesk's institutional funding partners.
